entries.claim: The approved Benziger printing's Ordo Missae prints the hand-position rubric selected in s01, from Deinde disiungit manus through et inclinatus dicit: Sanctus. The following Benedictus sign-of-the-cross direction and the preceding dialogue directions are outside this use. This is ritual support for s01, not a body-text witness or proof of the corpus's historical import workflow. The selected rubric capitalizes Præfationis; the print has lower-case præfationis.
